en-US.description: Run the Codex Remote Agent on Windows and reach the official Codex and Claude Code plugins from a phone.
en-US.installationNotes: Install and sign in to the Codex CLI before the first run. On startup, provide the Gateway address, access token, and server name, then accept the detected Codex or point to its entry file. The access token must match the Gateway Key used by the phone app.
en-US.longDescription:
Codex Remote lets a phone use the official Codex and Claude Code VS Code plugins directly: the server runs the official extension.js and loads the official chat interface, without reimplementing sessions, model selection, approvals, or multi-device coordination.
- Multiple work windows: open several projects at once, each backed by its own extension host and service, and switch between them without reconnecting.
- Tasks keep running on the computer when the phone locks, moves to the background, or briefly disconnects.
- The Agent connects out to the Gateway, so the server needs no inbound port and one Gateway can serve several Agents.
- The Windows Agent runs natively on Windows x64 without WSL. Closing the window parks it in the system tray, where you can start, stop, reconfigure, enable autostart, and check for updates.
- On Windows, chat and file operations are supported; the terminal and Claude Code are not. Configuration, logs, and plugin caches stay in the data folder of the installation directory.

zh-CN.author: chensunlai
zh-CN.description: 在 Windows 上运行 Codex Remote Agent，让手机接入电脑上的官方 Codex 与 Claude Code。
zh-CN.installationNotes: 使用前需要先安装并登录 Codex CLI。首次运行时填写 Gateway 地址、访问令牌与服务器名称，并选择自动检测到的 Codex 或手动指定其启动文件；访问令牌需与手机 App 中使用的 Gateway Key 一致。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Codex Remote 让手机直接使用官方 Codex 与 Claude Code 的 VS Code 插件：服务器上运行官方 extension.js 并加载官方聊天界面，不重写会话、模型选择、审批或多端协调逻辑。
- 多工作窗口：可同时打开多个项目，每个窗口使用独立的扩展宿主与后端，切换时无需重新连接。
- 任务驻留：任务在电脑上执行，手机锁屏、切换到后台或短暂断线不会中断已接受的任务。
- Agent 主动向 Gateway 建立连接，服务器无需开放入站端口，一个 Gateway 可以接入多个 Agent。
- Windows Agent 支持原生 Windows x64，不依赖 WSL；关闭窗口后收起到系统托盘，可在托盘中启动、停止、修改配置、设置登录后自动启动以及检查更新。
- Windows 当前支持聊天与文件操作，不提供终端与 Claude Code；配置、日志与插件缓存保存在安装目录的 data 文件夹。
